'''Arjan van den Broek''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 16th at [[1999 Etten-Leur Challenge Cup]] on 11 July 1999 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]] and [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned (Leia training)]], according to Vitor Alves Da Silva's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d26">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-30-etten-leur-netherlands-7-11-99d26/ etten-leur-netherlands-7-11-99], DeckTech (Vitor "Vitor" Alves da Silva, 30 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-30-etten-leur-netherlands-7-11-99d26/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
